'''Frugling''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Frugatoad]] at 3 bronze stars.

==Overview==
''"Frugling's idea of hospitality is offering dragon fruits to passing Tatari, not realizing they might pop in their faces and make a huge mess."''

Frugling is a purple rarity Tatari. Its name comes from a portmanteau of "frog", "fruit", and "-ling" (small, immature).

==Appearance==
A small, green, frog-like creature, with pink ears, a large drooling mouth, and large eyes that stare blankly. It has a pink dragonfruit on its back. It has a white underbelly and dark green on the tips of its digit-less hands and feet. 

Frugling's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces pink with purple, and green becomes neon green. Its brown pupils also become dark purple.

== Evolution Trial ==
Fruglings's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 3 bronze stars/6 copies. To evolve it into [[Frugatoad]] you need to complete the following task:
* Shoot 400 pinballs.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 2/10/2026, its bio used to say: "The dragon fruit on its back is not emergency food, so don't eat it!"
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Who would graft dragonfruit to their tails, instead of eating it right away? Well, the crazy Fruglings did."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/2026 its bio description said: "Driven by boundless curiosity, Fruglings poke their nose into everything, pulling pranks and feigning innocence when caught."

==Strategy==
[[File:Frugling Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Frugling's attack range]]
A very generic Grass DPS, best placed in the back to maximize damage output. Exploding dragonfruit can help clear clusters of enemies.
